note: D -- rules with at least one mutation observed provoking them. May rise, never fall. The entries are in enforce/discrimination.py and are meant to be read; the count alone says nothing about whether they are good.
why: Phase 1a: the matrix's first floor. Fourteen rules are observed rejecting a concrete mutation, twelve of which provoked on the first run. Two entries were wrong and the matrix said so -- ERR-013's insert broke parsing because delete is a method, and TEST-014's operands sat in a return where compound_gate examines conditions. Both were defects in the claim, not in the mechanism, which is the distinction this file exists to draw.
